ja303:1.1: Anuttare kāmaguṇe samiddhe bhutvāna pubbe vasi ekarājā, so dāni dugge narakamhi khitto na-ppajahe vaṇṇabalaṃ purāṇan ti.
ja303:2.1: Pubbe va khantī ca tapo ca mayhaṃ sampatthitā Dabbasenā ahosi, taṃ dāni laddhāna kathan nu rāja jahe ahaṃ vaṇṇabalaṃ purāṇaṃ.
ja303:3.1: Sabbaṃ kir' evaṃ pariniṭṭhitāni yasassinaṃ paññavataṃ visayha, yaso ca laddhā purimaṃ uḷāraṃ na-ppajahe vaṇṇabalaṃ purāṇaṃ.
ja303:4.1: Panujja dukkhena sukhaṃ janinda sukhena vā dukkham asayhasāhi ubhayattha sattā abhinibbutattā sukhe ca dukkhe ca bhavanti tulyā ti.
